title: Generalized Pattern: Connection Pool Failures (checkout-api, postgres-primary)
rule_text: When observing recurring connection_pool symptoms, the root cause is typically unreleased connections or slow downstream transactions saturating the pool. Inspect active checkout count and connection leak logs.
exceptions_text: Rule does not hold if the database instance itself is unreachable or returning TCP connection refused.
recommended_checks: Check for long-running uncommitted DB transactions

title: Generalized Pattern: Certificate Expiry Failures (payments-gateway)
rule_text: When TLS handshake failures or x509 certificate errors occur, verify certificate expiration dates on ingress routes and automated renewal cron jobs.
exceptions_text: Rule does not hold if the client TLS version is incompatible with server cipher suites.
trigger_signals: x509: certificate has expired or is not yet valid
recommended_checks: Inspect ingress TLS secret expiration with openssl

title: Generalized Pattern: Network Dns Failures (checkout-api, postgres-primary)
rule_text: When dial tcp or DNS lookup timeouts occur across multiple microservices, inspect CoreDNS pod health, node kube-dns endpoints, and upstream resolver latency.
exceptions_text: Rule does not hold if single-service egress security group rules were modified.
trigger_signals: dial tcp: lookup failed: i/o timeout
recommended_checks: Inspect CoreDNS logs and pod restarts
Verify kube-dns ClusterIP reachability from nodes

title: Generalized Pattern: Cache Issue Failures (inventory-service, redis-cache)
rule_text: When observing cache stampede or Redis saturation, inspect hot key eviction rates and ensure cache warming or single-flight request coalescing is active.
exceptions_text: Rule does not hold if Redis memory is exhausted due to missing TTL keys.
recommended_checks: Inspect Redis CPU and command latency

title: Generalized Pattern: Disk Full Failures (auth-service, checkout-api)
rule_text: When disk write errors or log rotation stalls occur, inspect log directories and container ephemeral storage volumes.
exceptions_text: Rule does not hold if inode exhaustion occurred with available disk space.
recommended_checks: Check df -h and df -i on affected nodes

title: Generalized Pattern: Capacity Traffic Failures (auth-service, inventory-service)
rule_text: When global request latency degrades with 429/503 errors during traffic spikes, enable rate limiting and scale out stateless replicas.
exceptions_text: Rule does not hold if downstream third-party APIs are rate-limiting inbound calls.
recommended_checks: Check ingress rate limit drop counters
Verify edge CDN cache offload ratio

title: Generalized Pattern: Bad Deploy Failures (auth-service, checkout-api)
rule_text: When error rates immediately surge within 5 minutes of a deployment, initiate automated rollback to previous known-good image tag.
exceptions_text: Rule does not hold if schema migrations were applied that are backwards-incompatible.
recommended_checks: Inspect git diff of latest deployment commit

title: Generalized Pattern: Dependency Failure Failures (auth-service, inventory-service)
rule_text: When an external upstream dependency fails or degrades, enable circuit breakers and fallback cached responses.
exceptions_text: Rule does not hold if the upstream failure is localized to a single tenant.

title: Generalized Pattern: Memory Leak Failures (checkout-api, inventory-service)
rule_text: When container OOMKilled restarts or GC pause spikes occur, inspect recent commit diffs for unclosed streams or unbounded in-memory caches.
exceptions_text: Rule does not hold if traffic volume grew by more than 300% without autoscaling.
recommended_checks: Review recent heap dumps and gc pause times

title: Generalized Pattern: Queue Backlog Failures (notification-worker, orders-service)
rule_text: When message consumer lag surges and message processing age exceeds SLA, scale consumer worker pools and inspect dead-letter queues.
exceptions_text: Rule does not hold if consumer crashes on poison pill payloads.
recommended_checks: Inspect DLQ error logs for poison payloads
